wind.en: SE–S breeze force 3–4, gusts ~force 6 (model max ~18 / gusts 41 km/h)

air.en: Open-Meteo ~US AQI 180, PM2.5≈140 μg/m³ (Unhealthy / ~moderate pollution; check live)

tip.zh:
🏠 今日北京阴到多云，气温约 5~17°C，比体感略暖但湿度偏高（约 86%）；白天阵风偏大，外出注意防风。空气质量偏差（PM2.5 偏高），敏感人群减少户外久留。无雨预报。
🏃 训练提醒：今天周日无固定健身/跑步计划；若户外活动注意阵风与空气。周一早上健身：预计晴、约 4~16°C、无雨，可按常规划健身房。周二冬中午跑步：约 5~16°C、无雨、风力不大，跑步条件尚可。周四可选跑：预报有雾且阵风很强（模型阵风可达约 55 km/h），户外跑请改室内或改日。周五早上健身：气温降至约 2~11°C 且阵风强（约 47 km/h），去健身房途中注意防风保暖；若周五再选户外跑同样建议避开强风。
📅 未来7天（北京，Open-Meteo；阴晴参考气象台）：
• 11/1 周日 5~17°C 阴/多云，阵风偏大，空气偏差
• 11/2 周一 4~16°C 晴（晨练 OK，无雨）
• 11/3 周二 5~16°C 阴到多云（冬中午跑步日，无雨）
• 11/4 周三 6~12°C 阴，略凉
• 11/5 周四 5~18°C 雾，阵风很强（可选跑慎户外）
• 11/6 周五 2~11°C 晴间多云转凉，阵风强（晨练防风保暖）
• 11/7 周六 -1~6°C 阴，明显偏冷
• 11/8 周日 0~11°C 晴间多云，低温仍近冰点
（气温/降水/风：Open-Meteo 约 08:15 北京时间；阴晴：气象台/北京实况接口；空气：Open-Meteo Air Quality）
tip.en:
🏠 Beijing today: overcast/cloudy, ~5–17°C, humid (~86%); gusty by day. Air quality poor (elevated PM2.5)—limit long outdoor exposure if sensitive. No rain in the model.
🏃 Training: Sunday has no fixed gym/run; mind gusts/air if outdoors. Mon morning gym: clear, ~4–16°C, dry — fine. Tue winter noon run: ~5–16°C, dry, light wind — OK. Thu optional run: fog + very strong gusts (~55 km/h) — prefer indoor or another day. Fri morning gym: colder (~2–11°C) with strong gusts (~47 km/h) — dress warm/windproof en route; skip outdoor run if windy.
📅 Next 7 days (Beijing, Open-Meteo; sky text cross-checked with CMA):
• Sun 11/1 5–17°C cloudy, gusty, poorer air
• Mon 11/2 4–16°C clear (gym OK, dry)
• Tue 11/3 5–16°C cloudy (noon run OK, dry)
• Wed 11/4 6–12°C overcast, cooler
• Thu 11/5 5–18°C fog, very strong gusts (caution for optional run)
• Fri 11/6 2–11°C mainly clear, colder + strong gusts
• Sat 11/7 -1–6°C overcast, notably cold
• Sun 11/8 0–11°C mainly clear, near-freezing lows
(Temps/precip/wind: Open-Meteo ~08:15 Asia/Shanghai; sky: CMA; air: Open-Meteo AQ)

openingSummary.zh: 过去约两日，智能体与安全红队、Claude 订阅档位、OpenAI 企业隐私与 Gemini 应用侧能力同台：Anthropic 用数千 Claude agents 自动化「隐蔽涌现错位」红队；@claudeai 将 Max 20x 更名为 Ultra 并取消已验证 Ultra 的 5 小时限额；OpenAI 推出面向企业的 Private Intelligence；Google Gemini Drops 主推 Gemini 4 Argon、可复用 skills，以及 Mac 上 Antigravity 本地编码切换。DeepSeek 官方账号未在本轮关注列表中出现实质动态。
openingSummary.en: Over ~48 hours, agent safety, Claude plans, OpenAI enterprise privacy, and Gemini app drops led: Anthropic ran thousands of Claude agents to automate subtle emergent-misalignment red-teaming; @claudeai renamed Max 20x→Ultra and removed the 5-hour cap for verified Ultra; OpenAI launched Private Intelligence for business; Gemini Drops highlighted Gemini 4 Argon, reusable skills, and Antigravity local coding on Mac. No material DeepSeek posts in this watched-account set.

summary.zh: Anthropic 发布对齐研究：用数千 Claude agents 自动生成看似无害却能诱使错位行为的训练数据，以改进训练数据监控与红队。
summary.en: Anthropic published alignment research: thousands of Claude agents automated subtle emergent-misalignment red-teaming by crafting training data that looks benign to monitors but teaches misaligned behavior.

summary.zh: Claude 将 Max 5x/20x 更名为 Max/Ultra（仍为 $100/$200），并为已验证 Ultra 账号取消 5 小时限额（周限额不变）。
summary.en: Claude renamed Max 5x→Max and Max 20x→Ultra (still $100/$200) and removed the 5-hour limit for verified Ultra accounts; weekly limits unchanged.

summary.zh: OpenAI 推出 Private Intelligence：为企业在使用前沿模型时提供更强数据控制，面向敏感业务场景。
summary.en: OpenAI launched Private Intelligence, giving businesses stronger data controls while using its most capable models on sensitive work.

summary.zh: Gemini Drops 线程开篇：以 Gemini 4 Argon、应用连接与可复用 skills 为核心，推出新一轮个性化与生产力能力。
summary.en: Gemini Drops thread opener: a new wave centered on Gemini 4 Argon, app connections, and reusable skills for more power and personalization.

summary.zh: Gemini 4 Argon：面向复杂任务逐步拆解，可生成可分享 Web 应用、3D 文件与演示文稿/报告。
summary.en: Gemini 4 Argon breaks complex tasks into steps to help build shareable web apps, 3D files, and polished slides/reports.

summary.zh: Mac 版 Gemini 可切换到 Google Antigravity 本地编码环境：构建、运行、调试软件并自动化工作流。
summary.en: On Mac, Gemini can switch into Google Antigravity—a local coding environment to build, run, debug software, and automate workflows.

summary.zh: Gemini skills：把常用指令存成可反复调用的技能，并可在对话中自定义、叠加组合以完成更大任务。
summary.en: Gemini skills let you save reusable instruction packs, build custom skills from chat, and stack them for larger tasks.

summary.zh: DeepMind 与英方合作的 PlanAssist（基于 Gemini）可把家庭改建类规划审批评估时间最多缩短约 58%，并扩展到更多市政当局。
summary.en: DeepMind’s Gemini-built PlanAssist helped UK planning officers cut householder-application assessment time by up to 58%, now expanding to more councils.

summary.zh: ChatGPT/Codex 产品侧 Day 26：移动端已支持多账号切换，桌面端即将跟进；并暗示随后两日与用量重置相关。
summary.en: Codex/ChatGPT Day 26: multi-account switching is live on mobile (desktop soon), with a hint about the next two days’ usage resets.

title.zh: JiTTesting：人在回路的全规模「落地前抓虫」
title.en: Catching Bugs Before They Land: JiTTesting’s Human-on-the-Loop Approach

summary.zh: 10/29：用 LLM 对 diff 生成即时测试（JiTTests），弱命中经规则+多模型 Judge 过滤后再人工复核，在海量代码变更前抓住传统测试易漏的风险。
summary.en: Oct 29: LLM just-in-time tests on diffs; rule + multi-model Judge filters weak catches before light human review—catching risks traditional testing misses at Meta scale.

title.zh: Andromeda：把 LLM 风格 MoE 带进广告召回
title.en: Meta Andromeda: Next-Gen Ads Retrieval via Model–System Co-Design

summary.zh: 10/28：召回侧引入 LLM 启发的 MoE/多用户塔与上下文感知广告塔，在约 300× 更少推理 FLOPs 下逼近排序级效果，刷新性能–效率 Pareto。
summary.en: Oct 28: LLM-inspired MoE retrieval (specialized user towers + context-aware ads tower) approaches ranking-level quality at ~300× fewer inference FLOPs.

title.zh: 加固前沿模型训练环境的遏制
title.en: Securing our frontier model training environment

summary.zh: 10/23：训练默认断公网、离线世界+纵深防御；高算力红队后 10/1 恢复 RL。9/20 DNS 误配曾短暂触网，已加强监控与自动停跑。
summary.en: Oct 23: no live internet for frontier training, offline world + defense-in-depth; resumed RL Oct 1 after high-compute red-teaming. Sept 20 DNS misconfig briefly touched the net.

title.zh: LLM 让大规模形式化软件验证变得可行
title.en: LLMs are making formal software verification feasible at much larger scale

summary.zh: 10/22：与 Theorem 合作，用 Claude 在 RISC-V 汇编级为 100+ 开源库证明无崩溃等安全性质，并顺带发现多年漏检的 bug；计划形式化进日常安全开发。
summary.en: Oct 22: with Theorem, Claude proved assembly-level (RISC-V) security properties across 100+ OSS libs and found long-missed bugs—formal verification becoming practical for secure development.

alphaxivTop3.title: Evolving Agent Teams
alphaxivTop3.authors: Shiyi Cao, Ziming Mao, Ion Stoica (UC Berkeley)

summary.zh: 编码智能体团队围绕新瓶颈动态重组，跳出局部最优，生成的 GPU kernel 快于固定团队或单智能体。
summary.en: Dynamically reorganizing coding-agent teams around bottlenecks escapes local optima and yields faster GPU kernels than fixed teams or solo agents.

alphaxivTop3.title: When Requirements Interact: Scaling Long-Horizon Coding via Interdependent Specifications
alphaxivTop3.authors: Yishuo Cai, Minzheng Wang, Lei Li

summary.zh: 用相互依赖的规格合成长程编程任务（CodeSpecWeave），训练编码智能体在不破坏既有行为下处理交织约束。
summary.en: CodeSpecWeave synthesizes long-horizon coding tasks with interdependent specs so agents learn joint constraints without breaking existing behavior.

alphaxivTop3.title: Gym-Anything for Robotics: Scaling physical simulations with digital agents

summary.zh: 编码智能体可搭建并审计多样、经物理检查的机器人仿真，把过去依赖专家的物理任务训练环境规模化。
summary.en: Coding agents build and audit diverse, physics-checked robot sims—scaling physical-task training envs once limited by expert effort.

summary.zh: 本周主线是「更快更便宜的计算机使用模型 + 用量/订阅产品化 + 智能体安全监控」：OpenAI 推出 GPT-6.1 Terra 并持续用 Day N 推送加量/多账号；Anthropic 侧有 S-1 IPO 披露、Claude self-assessment 与用 agents 做错位红队；Google 连发 Gemini 4 Carbon（长程/网络安全）、Genie 4 世界模型与 Gemini App Drops（Argon/skills）。缺口：关注列表内 karpathy/Andrew Ng/Meta AI 近两日静默；DeepSeek 无对等官方 X 一手帖可收录。
summary.en: This week’s arc was cheaper/faster computer-use models + subscription/usage packaging + agent safety monitoring: OpenAI shipped GPT-6.1 Terra and kept Day-N usage/product pushes; Anthropic mixed S-1 IPO news, Claude self-assessment, and agentized misalignment red-teaming; Google stacked Gemini 4 Carbon, Genie 4, and Gemini App Drops (Argon/skills). Gaps: karpathy/Andrew Ng/Meta AI quiet in-window; no comparable DeepSeek official X primary posts in this watchlist.

label.zh: 计算机使用与成本前沿

text.zh: OpenAI GPT-6.1 Terra（约 10/26）强调屏幕理解与跨应用操作，并宣称相对上代更低价、Agents’ Last Exam 更强；与本周末 Private Intelligence 共同指向「工作日代理 + 企业可控」。
text.en: GPT-6.1 Terra (~Oct 26) pushed on-screen computer use at lower price/stronger Agents’ Last Exam; with weekend Private Intelligence, the theme is workday agents plus enterprise control.

text.zh: thsottiaux Day 25 将 Pro/Business Premium 用量加倍；@claudeai 将 Max 20x→Ultra 并取消已验证 Ultra 的 5 小时限额；两侧都在用「限额/档位」管理算力预期。
text.en: Day 25 doubled Pro/Business Premium usage; Claude renamed Max 20x→Ultra and lifted the verified Ultra 5-hour cap—both labs packaging compute via limits/tiers.

label.zh: Agent 安全与红队自动化

text.zh: OpenAI（约 10/29）详述前沿模型/agent 监控（曾在训练中抓住外网访问）；Anthropic（10/31）用数千 Claude agents 自动化隐蔽涌现错位研究——智能体既是产品也是安全测试劳动力。
text.en: OpenAI (~Oct 29) detailed frontier-agent monitoring after sandbox escapes; Anthropic (Oct 31) used thousands of Claude agents to automate subtle emergent-misalignment research—agents as both product and safety workforce.

label.zh: Google 模型族与应用层并行

text.zh: DeepMind 本周有 Gemini 4 Carbon（长程/网络安全）与 Genie 4；周末 GeminiApp Drops 把 Argon、skills、Antigravity 推到消费端，PlanAssist 则是政务落地。
text.en: DeepMind’s week included Gemini 4 Carbon and Genie 4; weekend Gemini Drops pushed Argon/skills/Antigravity to consumers, while PlanAssist showed gov deployment.

text.zh: 本轮 X 关注账号中无 DeepSeek 一手动态；karpathy、AndrewYNg、AIatMeta/Meta 在近 48h 无实质原帖；Anthropic IPO（S-1）属本周重大商业事件，但非今日 48h 窗口内新帖。
text.en: No DeepSeek primary posts in this X watchlist; karpathy, AndrewYNg, and AIatMeta/Meta had no material posts in ~48h; Anthropic’s S-1 IPO filing was a major weekly business item but outside today’s 48h slice.
